# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_portrait_picker.txt - edit the source.
# Portrait picker (ADR-0036 with its amendment; portrait-layer design.txt and review.txt). The
# windows are generated (tools/modgen/features/portrait_picker.py): capie_v1_ed__rnpt__portrait for
# the player's own country leader (politics view) and capie_v1_ed__rnpt__subportrait for another
# country's leader (diplomacy view). The catalog lookups are generated (rn_portrait_catalog.txt:
# rn_pp_catalog, rn_pp_group_of, rn_pp_fill_group, rn_pp_fill_letter, rn_pp_entry_info).
#
# U2: the chosen portrait replaces only the country-leader (civilian) portrait of the person who
# leads the country when the player applies; army and navy portraits stay the game's.
#
# State (on ROOT, the player), as in the flag picker (rn_flag_picker.txt) with prefix rn_pp_:
#   flags rn_pp_open_own / rn_pp_open_sub, rn_pp_view_target, rn_pp_has_layer;
#   rn_pp_target + rn_pp_target_arr   the country, pinned at opening;
#   rn_pp_char_arr                    its country leader at opening (one character);
#   rn_pp_kind                        1 leaders' portraits, 2 generals' and admirals';
#   rn_pp_view, rn_pp_src(_arr), rn_pp_letter, paging, rn_pp_list/_cells/_rows, rn_pp_sel/_init.
# On the country: the portrait cooldown rn_ip_cd_portrait_until / _date (its own counter, the same
# length as the name's, like the flag's). On the leader character: the CAPIE layer capie_pt_*
# (contract section 18, written only by rn_character_portrait_carrier_set) and the mod's own
# rn_pt_idx / rn_pt_cat (catalog index and fingerprint).
#
# Errors (temp rn_cv1_err): 10 CAPIE missing, 11 cooldown, 12 stale opening, 13 editor unavailable,
# 15 CAPIE older than API level 7, 16 CAPIE without the portrait layer (capie_portrait is not 1),
# 17 portrait not in the pool of the current rule, 18 the country has another leader now,
# 20 not allowed, 21 switched off by the host.

rn_pp_touch = {
	add_to_variable = { rn_pp_dirty = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_dirty > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_pp_dirty = 1 } }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- rules

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- opening, closing

# Own country (politics view). Scope: the player.
rn_pp_open_own = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = ROOT
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_ip_country_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_ip_party_neutrality_open }
			rn_pp_own_allowed = yes
		}
		rn_inline_leader_cancel = yes
		rn_fp_close = yes
		rn_pp_close = yes
		clear_array = rn_pp_target_arr
		add_to_array = { rn_pp_target_arr = THIS }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_target = THIS }
		set_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own
		rn_pp_open_common = yes
	}
}

# Another country (diplomacy view). Scope: that country; ROOT is the player.
rn_pp_open_sub = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { rn_feature_portrait_off = yes }
			NOT = { rn_feature_subjects_off = yes }
			rn_sub_may_edit = yes
			rn_pp_sub_allowed = yes
			ROOT = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input } }
		}
		ROOT = {
			rn_sub_close = yes
			rn_fac_close = yes
			rn_fp_close = yes
			rn_pp_close = yes
			clear_array = rn_pp_target_arr
			add_to_array = { rn_pp_target_arr = PREV }
			set_variable = { rn_pp_target = PREV }
			set_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub
			rn_pp_open_common = yes
		}
	}
}

# ROOT scope, target pinned. Pins the target's country leader and preselects its portrait when this
# mod set it (the game's own portrait has no script getter; the politics view shows it).
rn_pp_open_common = {
	add_to_variable = { rn_pp_epoch = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_pp_epoch = 1 } }
	rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
	clear_array = rn_pp_char_arr
	var:rn_pp_target = {
		every_character = {
			limit = { is_country_leader = yes }
			ROOT = { add_to_array = { rn_pp_char_arr = PREV } }
		}
	}
	rn_pp_catalog = yes
	set_variable = { rn_pp_init = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = rn_pp_has_layer
	var:rn_pp_target = {
		every_character = {
			limit = { is_country_leader = yes is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_pp_char_arr value = THIS } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_pt_ver } ROOT = { set_country_flag = rn_pp_has_layer } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = capie_pt_ver has_variable = rn_pt_idx check_variable = { rn_pt_cat = temp_var:rn_pp_cat } }
				set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_t = rn_pt_idx }
				ROOT = { set_variable = { rn_pp_init = temp_var:rn_pp_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { rn_pp_sel = rn_pp_init }
	set_variable = { rn_pp_kind = 1 }
	set_variable = { rn_pp_letter = 1 }
	rn_pp_show_target = yes
}

# ROOT scope. Closes either picker; safe to call when none is open.
rn_pp_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub } }
		add_to_variable = { rn_pp_epoch = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_pp_epoch = 1 } }
	}
	clr_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own
	clr_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub
	clr_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target
	clr_country_flag = rn_pp_has_layer
	clear_array = rn_pp_target_arr
	clear_array = rn_pp_char_arr
	clear_array = rn_pp_src_arr
	clear_array = rn_pp_list
	clear_array = rn_pp_cells
	clear_array = rn_pp_rows
	clear_variable = rn_pp_target
	clear_variable = rn_pp_src
	clear_variable = rn_pp_sel
	clear_variable = rn_pp_init
	clear_variable = rn_pp_view
	clear_variable = rn_pp_page
	clear_variable = rn_pp_pages
	clear_variable = rn_pp_page_disp
	rn_pp_touch = yes
}

# ROOT scope. The "Name" tab of the own picker: back to the leader name editor.
rn_pp_to_name_editor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own
			NOT = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_leader = yes }
			NOT = { rn_feature_leader_off = yes }
		}
		rn_pp_close = yes
		rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rn_ip_lui_rev } } set_variable = { rn_ip_lui_rev = 0 } }
		rn_inline_leader_open = yes
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- navigation

# ROOT scope. The target's own portraits.
rn_pp_show_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { rn_pp_is_open = yes }
		clear_array = rn_pp_src_arr
		var:rn_pp_target = { ROOT = { add_to_array = { rn_pp_src_arr = PREV } } }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_src = rn_pp_target }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_view = 1 }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 }
		set_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target
		rn_pp_build = yes
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Country list of the current letter (only when the rule offers other countries).
rn_pp_show_list = {
	if = {
		limit = { rn_pp_is_open = yes rn_pp_rule_all = yes }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target
		rn_pp_build = yes
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Input temp rn_pp_k: 1 leaders, 2 generals (only when the rule offers generals).
rn_pp_set_kind = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			rn_pp_is_open = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_k = 1 }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_k = 2 } rn_pp_rule_generals = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { rn_pp_kind = temp_var:rn_pp_k }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 }
		rn_pp_build = yes
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Input temp rn_pp_lt: letter 1..26.
rn_pp_pick_letter = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			rn_pp_is_open = yes
			rn_pp_rule_all = yes
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_lt > 0 }
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_lt < 27 }
		}
		set_variable = { rn_pp_letter = temp_var:rn_pp_lt }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target
		rn_pp_build = yes
	}
}

# Scope: the country of a list row; ROOT is the player.
rn_pp_pick_country = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { rn_pp_is_open = yes check_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 } }
			rn_pp_rule_all = yes
			is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_pp_rows value = THIS }
		}
		ROOT = {
			clear_array = rn_pp_src_arr
			add_to_array = { rn_pp_src_arr = PREV }
			set_variable = { rn_pp_src = PREV }
			set_variable = { rn_pp_view = 1 }
			set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target
			if = { limit = { is_in_array = { array = rn_pp_target_arr value = PREV } } set_country_flag = rn_pp_view_target }
			rn_pp_build = yes
		}
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Input temp rn_pp_pick: a catalog index shown on the current page.
rn_pp_pick_cell = {
	if = {
		limit = { rn_pp_is_open = yes is_in_array = { array = rn_pp_cells value = temp_var:rn_pp_pick } }
		set_variable = { rn_pp_sel = temp_var:rn_pp_pick }
		rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
		rn_pp_touch = yes
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Input temp rn_pp_step: -1 or 1.
rn_pp_page_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { rn_pp_is_open = yes }
		add_to_variable = { rn_pp_page = temp_var:rn_pp_step }
		rn_pp_build = yes
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Fills rn_pp_list for the current view and kind; copies the current page (six
# portraits, or ten countries) to rn_pp_cells or rn_pp_rows.
rn_pp_build = {
	clear_array = rn_pp_list
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 } }
		rn_pp_fill_letter = yes
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_per = 10 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_g = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = rn_pp_src } var:rn_pp_src = { rn_pp_group_of = yes } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_g > 0 } } rn_pp_fill_group = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_per = 6 }
	}
	set_variable = { rn_pp_pages = rn_pp_list^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { rn_pp_pages = 9 }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_m = rn_pp_pages }
		modulo_temp_variable = { var = rn_pp_m value = 10 }
		subtract_from_variable = { rn_pp_pages = rn_pp_m }
		divide_variable = { rn_pp_pages = 10 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { rn_pp_pages = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_m = rn_pp_pages }
		modulo_temp_variable = { var = rn_pp_m value = 6 }
		subtract_from_variable = { rn_pp_pages = rn_pp_m }
		divide_variable = { rn_pp_pages = 6 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_pages < 1 } } set_variable = { rn_pp_pages = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_last = rn_pp_pages }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { rn_pp_last = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_page > rn_pp_last } } set_variable = { rn_pp_page = rn_pp_last } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_page < 0 } } set_variable = { rn_pp_page = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_lo = rn_pp_page }
	multiply_temp_variable = { rn_pp_lo = rn_pp_per }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_hi = rn_pp_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { rn_pp_hi = rn_pp_per }
	clear_array = rn_pp_cells
	clear_array = rn_pp_rows
	for_each_loop = {
		array = rn_pp_list
		value = rn_pp_e
		index = rn_pp_i
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { rn_pp_i < rn_pp_lo } }
				check_variable = { rn_pp_i < rn_pp_hi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rn_pp_view = 2 } }
				add_to_array = { rn_pp_rows = rn_pp_e }
			}
			else = { add_to_array = { rn_pp_cells = rn_pp_e } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { rn_pp_page_disp = rn_pp_page }
	add_to_variable = { rn_pp_page_disp = 1 }
	rn_pp_touch = yes
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Apply, Restore

# ROOT scope. Host switches (ADR-0036): 21, before every other error.
rn_pp_switch = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				rn_feature_portrait_off = yes
				AND = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub rn_feature_subjects_off = yes }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 21 }
	}
}

# ROOT scope. 20 when the picker is not open for a target the player may change now, 18 when the
# pinned person no longer leads the target.
rn_pp_rights = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 }
			OR = {
				is_ai = yes
				has_country_flag = rn_open
				has_country_flag = rn_input
				NOT = { has_variable = rn_pp_target }
				NOT = { check_variable = { rn_pp_target_arr^num = 1 } }
				NOT = { rn_pp_is_open = yes }
				AND = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own NOT = { var:rn_pp_target = { tag = ROOT } } }
				AND = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own NOT = { rn_pp_own_allowed = yes } }
				AND = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub NOT = { var:rn_pp_target = { rn_sub_may_edit = yes rn_pp_sub_allowed = yes } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { rn_pp_char_arr^num = 1 } }
				NOT = { var:rn_pp_target = { any_character = { is_country_leader = yes is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_pp_char_arr value = THIS } } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 18 }
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Output temp rn_pp_ok = 1 when rn_pp_sel is in the pool of rn_portrait_pool for the
# target (CONTRACT section 9: the effect decides). U1: "own country and generals" means the target's
# own generals and admirals.
rn_pp_sel_allowed = {
	rn_pp_catalog = yes
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_ok = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_w = rn_pp_sel }
	rn_pp_entry_info = yes
	var:rn_pp_target = { rn_pp_group_of = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_ANY_LEADER }
					check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_leader = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_OWN }
					check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_leader = 1 }
					check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_g = temp_var:rn_pp_g }
				}
				AND = {
					has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_OWN_GENERALS }
					check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_g = temp_var:rn_pp_g }
					OR = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_leader = 1 } check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_general = 1 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_ALL }
					OR = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_leader = 1 } check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_general = 1 } }
				}
			}
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_e_g > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_ok = 1 }
	}
}

# ROOT scope. Apply of either picker: CAPIE header (epoch, API level 7, capie_portrait = 1),
# switches, rights and rules, the target's portrait cooldown and the pool, then the carrier on the
# pinned leader.
rn_pp_apply = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_open = rn_pp_epoch }
	rn_cv1_header = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_cap > 6 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_portrait = 1 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 16 }
	}
	rn_pp_switch = yes
	rn_pp_rights = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } var:rn_pp_target = { rn_pp_cooldown_active = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		rn_pp_sel_allowed = yes
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_pp_ok = 1 } } } set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 17 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_pt_in = rn_pp_sel }
		var:rn_pp_target = {
			every_character = {
				limit = { is_country_leader = yes is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_pp_char_arr value = THIS } }
				rn_character_portrait_carrier_set = yes
			}
			rn_pp_cooldown_start = yes
			rn_country_portrait_commit = yes
		}
		rn_pp_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}

# ROOT scope. "Restore portrait": removes the layer of the pinned leader (the game's current
# portrait shows again), under the portrait cooldown. Needs no CAPIE.
rn_pp_reset = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 0 }
	rn_pp_switch = yes
	rn_pp_rights = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } var:rn_pp_target = { rn_pp_cooldown_active = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } has_country_flag = rn_pp_has_layer }
		var:rn_pp_target = {
			every_character = {
				limit = { is_country_leader = yes is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_pp_char_arr value = THIS } }
				rn_character_portrait_carrier_clear = yes
			}
			rn_pp_cooldown_start = yes
			rn_country_portrait_commit = yes
		}
		rn_pp_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}

# Portrait cooldown (scope: the country): its own counter, the same length as the name's.
rn_pp_cooldown_start = {
	rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_portrait_until = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { rn_ip_cd_portrait_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_portrait_date = global.date }
}
